answer_1.quote: We present a neural model that takes a real‑world map representation from OpenStreetMap as input and generates navigation instructions that contain salient landmarks, learned directly from human natural language instructions…

answer_2.quote: BLEU is calculated with SacreBLEU on lower‑cased and tokenized text. Length is the average length in number of tokens. Landmarks is the number of landmark occurrences per instance… SDTW is success weighted by normalized Dynamic Time Warping. SR is the first try success rate… SNT is success weighted by navigation time.
automatic_metrics: SDTW (Success weighted by normalized Dynamic Time Warping)

answer_4.quote: If one of two annotators did so successfully, the navigation instructions were considered valid… The task is successful if the annotator stops the run within a 25 meter radius around the goal location.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators (via Amazon Mechanical Turk) are asked to follow the generated navigation instructions in Google Street View and stop when they believe the goal is reached; success is defined by proximity to the true goal.
